name: Lemon juice on pimples

lead: Some people apply lemon juice to pimples, citing its citric acid and vitamin C.
No clinical studies on lemon juice for acne were found.

paras: Believers credit the acidity and vitamin C; research has not tested this for acne.
Citrus juice on skin followed by sun exposure can cause phytophotodermatitis with blistering and pigmentation lasting years.

lead: Dabbing lemon juice on pimples is a home remedy for acne and dark marks. Proponents cite its acidity and vitamin C.

Lemon juice is about 5-6% citric acid and a rich source of vitamin C [1]. Contact between skin and citrus juice followed by sunlight can cause phytophotodermatitis, a reaction that may leave pigmentation lasting years [2]. No studies of lemon juice for acne were found.

paras: Phytophotodermatitis follows contact with light-sensitising plant compounds (furanocoumarins) and UVA exposure; redness and burning appear within 24 hours, blisters can form within 48 hours, and brown or purplish discolouration can last for years [2]. Wikipedia's article names lime juice as the example and does not specifically mention lemon [2].
